mathematical_audit.pullback: For q=2u-v and C=p^(-1)F_Omega^*, C^j(dq)=2u^(p^j-1)du-v^(p^j-1)dv, so the Item377 resolvent gives the displayed exact two-moment connection.
mathematical_audit.splitting: The formal primitive f=sum_j p^(-j)F^j(q) satisfies df=-omega and F(f)/p-f=-q. Direct semilinear multiplication therefore sends U(f)^(-1)A_qF(U(f)) to diag(p,1) while killing the connection.
mathematical_audit.forced_denominators: Solving dG=-E21*omega*G makes the top row constant and forces at least one lower entry of every fundamental gauge to contain a nonzero constant multiple of f. Coefficients on the primitive Frobenius orbit have valuations -j, so f is not in W[[u,v]][1/p] and no fixed vertical p-pole clears the gauge.
mathematical_audit.rational_dagger_scope: The one-variable restriction has unit coefficients at p^j-1 and arbitrarily long zero gaps. It is neither rational nor overconvergent, and a gauge lying in either same category cannot transform it into that category. This closes only the direct standard-Frobenius moment model.
mathematical_audit.specialization_warning: The u,v construction is a direct coordinate model, not a proved Frobenius-equivariant descent from all pointwise finite-log coordinates. Their p^2-O(p) ambient cotangent directions can have rank at most two after a two-parameter pullback and supply no geometric conductor lower bound.
mathematical_audit.capacity: No weighted joint-zero estimate follows. The shared fixed-j=1 ceiling remains 1/36 and zero is booked.
